evidence.summary: The UN Security Council listed the Defense Technology and Science Research Center (DTSRC) in resolution 1929 (2010) as owned or controlled by, or acting on behalf of, Iran’s Ministry of Defense and Armed Forces Logistics (MODAFL), which oversees Iran’s defence research and production, and described Malek Ashtar University as a subordinate of the center within MODAFL. OFAC lists it as a government entity linked to MODAFL, on Pasdaran Avenue in Tehran.
It belongs to Iran’s Ministry of Defense and Armed Forces Logistics (MODAFL).
